title: Ban Hammer
description: This Texture pack transform the mace in to a ban hammer and change windburst effect
body:
**this resource pack that swaps the vanilla mace and smash attack particles with a BAN text.**
![mace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38cc6df3544de908369c5c3845843bd9c49363d2.png)Whenever you land a heavy drop attack on someone, instead of the regular wind/smoke effect, a bunch of "BAN" signs will explode out of the ground.
